title: Laboratory Protocol Guide

origin.title: ibidi Application Guide: Immunofluorescence Assays (FL_AG_039, V 1.0 2019/09)
origin.clearance_note: A vendor's own application guide, published on its website as a free resource. Downloaded by script directly from the publisher's domain. PDF metadata cleared. The example-image pages carry published data credits naming the scientists who supplied the micrographs; these are professional attributions in the publisher's own document, kept as printed and not featured. Contact details are the company's corporate addresses and phone lines.

notes: No feature page or fields were requested; chosen here. Page 8 (Troubleshooting) features the High Background table: its heading and two complete reason/solution rows, insufficient blocking and not enough washing, both of which tie back to protocol steps described earlier in the guide. The two ruled troubleshooting tables ground cell by cell; every reason and solution resolves to its own cell (occurrence 0 is pinned because each also grounds, OFF, to its table's heading). The protocol-step pages were not featured: page 4's fixation and permeabilization text parsed as figure blocks, so values there box the whole column, and the protocol_steps array came back out of document order.
